LanguageData.Gun_SV-98_RWP.description: The SV-98 is a bolt-action sniper rifle renowned for its accuracy and long range. It is ideal for picking off distant targets with precision but has a slow rate of fire, requiring careful aim and timing. Suitable for colonists with high shooting skills, it packs a powerful punch but demands patience and skill to use effectively.
